title: Declare the URN side segment as frontend or backend by real ownership

values: file in a repository governed by the Bun stack realization
facts.note: Bun realization scope: the rule applies wherever the Bun per-stack detector (bun_green_traceability_detector) is the selected realization; no language or file-extension restriction is implied. Needs a stack/realization selector.

values: file carrying a URN traceability header with exactly six segments
facts.note: Requires parsing the header URN and splitting it into segments. Applies to any such header, pre-existing or newly written; writing or editing a file is an example trigger, not a necessary condition.
Emitted by bun_green_traceability_detector when segment 4 of a six-segment URN is not frontend/backend.

values: URN segment 4 value vs the module's real ownership (browser-owned vs server-owned)
facts.note: The detector checks only the closed vocabulary; whether the side matches where responsibility lives needs judgment.

fires: A Bun-realization file is written with a six-segment URN header.
An existing six-segment URN header (touched or not) has segment 4 set to something other than `frontend` or `backend` (e.g. empty, `shared`, `server`).
A module that renders server-side fragments is labelled `frontend`, or browser-resident behavior is labelled `backend`.
An implementation edit moves a module's responsibility between browser and server while its URN header is left untouched.
doesNotFire: The URN in the header does not have six segments (this check is skipped).

Only the `Runtime:` header line differs (e.g. a `backend` file declaring `Runtime: isomorphic`) AND segment 4 is in the closed vocabulary and matches real ownership. `Runtime:` neither triggers nor waives the side obligation.
Files without a URN traceability header, or repositories not using the Bun realization (served by their own per-stack detectors).

given: A file in a Bun-realization repo carries a six-segment URN header; in a stack-spanning repo side cannot be inferred from language or runtime.
when: The header exists or is written/edited, or the file's implementation changes which side owns it.
then: Segment 4 (`{side}`) must be exactly `frontend` for browser-owned or `backend` for server-owned implementation.
prefer: During GREEN repair, derive side from where responsibility lives, not merely from file syntax.
Treat server-rendered htmx fragments as backend and browser-resident behavior as frontend.
When the rest of the URN is correct, change only the side segment.
avoid: Moving implementation between client and server just to fix a header.
Using `Runtime:` as a substitute for the side decision.
unless: URNs that are not six segments are skipped.
`Runtime:` is a different axis — a `backend` file may declare `Runtime: isomorphic`.
why: In a full-stack Bun repo one language and runtime span both halves, so segment 4 alone says which side a module belongs to and must be declared per file (unlike Vite repos, frontend by construction, or python-pytest services, backend by construction, where it is near-redundant).
evidence: bun_green_traceability_detector reports no GREEN-URN-005 / BUN-GREEN-URN-SIDE-001 finding.
Reviewer confirms the side segment matches the implementation's real ownership (browser-owned → frontend, server-owned → backend).
verifier_detail: Check URN segment 4 (1-indexed) against the closed vocabulary {`frontend`, `backend`}; the vocabulary is unchanged from the Python and Vite realizations.
Only evaluate URNs with exactly six segments; URNs with any other segment count are skipped by this check.
Do not read the `Runtime:` header line for this check; `backend` + `Runtime: isomorphic` is valid. Runtime is independent: it neither triggers nor waives the side/ownership check.
Severity 3; disposition strict (fails on every finding).
audit: schema_version 1.1.0; kind rule; status active; introduced_in 0.1.0.
Stack-neutral obligation, Bun-specific detector; implementation: validator `bun_green_traceability_detector`.

Term ids: side_segment (segment 4: frontend or backend — which half of the application the file belongs to); stack_spanning_repo (one language and one runtime serve both halves, so side cannot be inferred from the stack and must be declared per file).
Summary: a "side is declared from the closed vocabulary" obligation, checked against segment 4.

sharedNodes.text: Prove: the current behavioral acceptance passes.

additions.justification: Restates the source's closed-vocabulary obligation (S006/S013) as an explicit anti-pattern; no new obligation.

additions.text: fires/doesNotFire examples, Bun-realization scope fact and observability notes, including that implementation edits shifting ownership fire the rule and that Runtime-only differences are exempt only when the side already matches real ownership.
additions.justification: Required by the output schema; derived from the source statement (S007 Bun-specific detector), exceptions (S029, S030) and ownership proof (S028). No language, create/edit or phase gate is added.

additions.text: Runtime neither triggers nor waives the side/ownership check.
additions.justification: Clarifies S030 ('different axis') so the exception is not read as a waiver of S028's ownership requirement.
